label: v245
changes: An adult's profile now has a "Spouse or partner" field, sitting just above the work details. It takes a name, whether or not that person is in your vault — an adult child's husband or a grandparent's late wife belong there just as much as someone already on file.
It says "or partner" on purpose. Plenty of people have a life partner they never married, and a vault that can only record a marriage records the wrong thing for them.
Like the work details, it appears from 18 and not before.

The assistant can fill it in when you tell it ("my wife Maria"), and it is told in as many words never to work one out for itself. Two adults sharing a surname, an address, or a family space are not evidence of a marriage, and a relationship it assumed and filed would be invisible to the people it was wrong about.
